description: This file contains the implementation of the DataTables Select extension, providing API methods, event handlers, and buttons for row, column, and cell selection within DataTables. It includes initialization, selection/deselection logic, event management, and integration with MDBootstrap.

methods.name: DataTable.select
methods.description: Namespace object containing version info, initialization, and API methods for selection.

methods.description: Version of the DataTables select extension.

methods.description: Initializes selection settings for a DataTable instance.
